events.headline: CONTAINER SHIP HIT BY PROJECTILE SINKS IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ, SINGAPORE SAYS
events.detail: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.
